data.actual_behavior: Manual Tint was exposed but produced no visible change while the default citizen_skin material was selected.
evidence: User-provided s&box editor screenshots recorded in the conversation.
data.expected_behavior: Changing Dresser Manual Tint changes the visible character skin tone.
reproduction_steps: Select the character Body in scenes/basic_example.scene.
Add or select the Dresser component and change Manual Tint.
Observe no expected visible skin-tone update with citizen_skin selected.
data.title: Citizen skin tint did not visibly update

findings: Dresser was added to the Body object that owns the visible SkinnedModelRenderer.
The Dresser Manual Tint control was present and changed numerically.
hypotheses: The assigned skin material may not support or expose the Dresser manual attributes used by this character setup.
missing_information: Whether the editor scene change has been saved to disk was not independently checked.
The later player-operated interaction remains unimplemented.

evidence: User-provided editor screenshots show the material change and visible tint differences.
data.root_cause: The selected citizen_skin material did not visibly respond to the Dresser manual attributes in this setup; the citizen_skin01 material did respond.

data.approved_scope: Manual editor material assignment only; no gameplay code or project settings.
data.proposed_repair: Use citizen_skin01.vmat_c in the Body renderer material slot before adjusting Dresser Manual Tint.
regression_tests: Change Manual Tint to two distinct values and confirm a visible skin-tone difference.
risks: The material override must be saved with the scene if it is intended to persist.
This does not implement player interaction.

data.outcome: In the editor, the material was changed to citizen_skin01 and Manual Tint produced the expected visible skin-tone change.
data.rollback: Restore the prior material slot if the original appearance is required.

limitations: Scene save persistence was not independently checked.
Player-operated object interaction was not tested.
regression_checks: Confirm the Body material remains citizen_skin01 before changing Dresser Manual Tint.

tests.evidence: Editor screenshots and the project learning log show distinct visible results at Manual Tint values 0.086 and 0.955.
tests.name: Manual Tint with citizen_skin01

data.closure_evidence: Manual skin-tone update is visually verified in the s&box editor after selecting citizen_skin01.vmat_c.

data.description: When a character property does not produce the expected visual change, inspect both the controlling component and the assigned material before changing gameplay code.
